message: bridge-deduction-d-fail (deduction-d-fail:test_social_deduction_d): a fresh game; facts granted from the console (exercised, not earned); stops brought forward with the door objects; KO Volkov; a wrong call on Chen; the loss ends in honest credits. Sidecar DRAFT outline.

fn: async () => { /* F0 grant all 18 facts from the console and install the toast spy */ window.__toasts = window.__toasts || []; if (!window.__toastSpy) { window.__toastSpy = true; const orig = window.gameAlert; window.gameAlert = (...a) => { window.__toasts.push({ t: Date.now(), a }); return orig ? orig(...a) : undefined; }; } const facts = Object.keys(window.gameScenario.social.intelFacts); for (const f of facts) window.deductionRuntime.grantFact(f, { source: 'console' }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800)); const G = window.gameState.globalVariables; return facts.length === 18 && facts.every(f => G['se_intel_' + f] === true);  }

async () => { /* F1 every fact was already held, so stops 1 to 3 faded nothing (tamper picks the first fact not held) */ await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000)); const G = window.gameState.globalVariables; return window.deductionRuntime.getState().state.faded.length === 0 && ['d_sato_pass','d_chen_charm','d_devries_sim'].every(f => G['deduction_faded_' + f] === false);  }

async () => { /* F3 MISSION COMPLETE check 1/3: the conclusion screen opened (or opens) under CASE CLOSED; nothing says MISSION COMPLETE */ const h = document.querySelector('.bv-title-block h1'); const tk = document.querySelector('.bv-ticker-inner'); return !/MISSION COMPLETE/.test(document.body.textContent) && (!h || /CASE CLOSED/.test(h.textContent)) && (!tk || !/MISSION COMPLETE/.test(tk.textContent));  }
() => { window.__preReload = true; setTimeout(() => location.assign(location.pathname + "?skip_resume=1"), 50); return true; }

async () => { /* F5 MISSION COMPLETE check 3/3: the visualiser reopens under CASE CLOSED with the neutral ticker and no credits list (AP-2: the loss credits are not replayed); no end card; the board is read-only */ await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3000)); const h = document.querySelector('.bv-title-block h1'); const tk = document.querySelector('.bv-ticker-inner'); const body = document.body.textContent; const R = window.deductionRuntime; R.setMark('ded_d_mensah', 'guilty', { profile: 'keyholder' });
  return !!h && /CASE CLOSED/.test(h.textContent) && !!tk && /NIGHT TRAIN/.test(tk.textContent) && !/MISSION COMPLETE/.test(body) && !document.querySelector('.scenario-end-screen') && R.getState().state.marks.ded_d_mensah.mark === 'clear';  }
